description: SVG references, a mask box image, a drop shadow and a rounded clip over a mask at a device pixel ratio of 2

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 400px; height: 200px; background-color: #ffffff; } .b { position: absolute; width: 100px; height: 50px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 6px solid #2a3a58; } .p0 { left: 20px; top: 20px; background-color: #d05040; mask: url(#m1); } .p1 { left: 145px; top: 20px; background-color: #40a060; clip-path: url(#c1); } .p2 { left: 270px; top: 20px; background-color: #4070d0; filter: url(#f3); } .p3 { left: 20px; top: 110px; background-color: #e0b030; -webkit-mask-box-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='60' height='60'><rect width='60' height='60' fill='%23000' fill-opacity='0.2'/><rect width='20' height='20' fill='%23000'/><rect x='40' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000'/><rect y='40' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000'/><rect x='40' y='40' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000'/><rect x='20' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000' fill-opacity='0.5'/><rect x='20' y='40' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000' fill-opacity='0.5'/><rect y='20' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000' fill-opacity='0.5'/><rect x='40' y='20' width='20' height='20' fill='%23000' fill-opacity='0.5'/></svg>") 20 / 20px; } .p4 { left: 145px; top: 110px; background-color: #a050c0; filter: drop-shadow(4px 4px 3px #000000); } .p5 { left: 270px; top: 110px; background-color: #30a0b0; mask-image: linear-gradient(#000, transparent); clip-path: inset(6px round 12px); }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows at a device pixel ratio of 2: 0.17% of the pixels differ by more than 8 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box. It covers an SVG mask, clip and filter, a mask box image, a drop shadow and a rounded clip over a gradient mask, so that lengths in them scale with the display. With the effects ignored the same fixture measures 31.04%, so it fails.
